title: Auto-archiving
description: Automatically archives recordings once the period has elapsed (measured from the recording time) — same effect as “Archive” in the row menu. Archived recordings disappear from “Current” and can be restored at any time from the Archive tab.
daysInvalid: Please enter a whole number between 1 and 3650.
daysInvalidToast: Period must be a whole number between 1 and 3650
hint: Checked every 6 hours; changed values take effect without a restart. Recordings manually restored from the archive are left alone until the period ends again.
